title: window-contract
description: Two kind-discriminated shapes: the since-watermark window the cycle hands the source adapter (poll-window), and the records-in-window answer the adapter hands back. The floor is a fixed field on both; nothing before it is ever read (goal.md clause 15).

floor.description: the owner-ruled processing start date; fixed, never derived from launch time

oneOf.description: poll-window: what the cycle asks the source adapter to sweep

since.description: the last successful poll's watermark; absent on the first poll, where the floor alone bounds the sweep

oneOf.description: records-in-window: what the source adapter hands back

accounts.description: per-account coverage: every account the sweep was asked for appears here

covered.description: false when this account's sweep did not complete; a failure event names why
